title: Frick the Deep Dark - 1.18.2ify your game
description: trims the lower-quality microsoft content from after 1.18.2
body:
removes the mediocre content additions from 1.18.2 onward
i really dislike what microsoft have done with the game since then and this pack serves to allow compatibility with more modern mods without having to have those fricking sniffing animals in your game.

note that it cannot effectively block mob spawns so i recommend using 'you shall not spawn' or 'in control'



**allows:**

- Cherry grove + cherry wood/items
- Mangrove swamp + mud + mangrove wood/items
- Bamboo wood/block/items
- copper cosmetic blocks
- tuff cosmetic blocks
- Crafter
- Netherite Upgrade Smithing Template route
- Frogs and froggy stuff


**blocks/suppresses:**

- Deep Dark biome content
- Ancient Cities
- sculk / echo shard / recovery compass
- Trail Ruins
- archaeology loot
- sniffer plant access: torchflower / pitcher plant
- Trial Chambers
- trial vault/spawner loot
- breeze rod / wind charge / mace route
- armadillo scute / wolf armour
- goat horns
- non-netherite armour trim templates
- new 1.21 music discs/banner patterns tied to trial content
